description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android app that manages two Floating Action Buttons (FABs). The fragment inflates a layout, sets up listeners for the FABs, and logs their toggle states when changed.

classes.name: FloatingActionButtonBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages two Floating Action Buttons, setting up check change listeners and logging their states.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout containing the FABs, sets up listeners for each FAB, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles toggle events for the FABs, logging whether each FAB is checked or unchecked.
